scope: Bounded existing-task duplicate start, stop and restart acceptance
reviewed: Every task operation selects exact root task path
Full canonical principal/trigger/action/settings checks and unchanged XML before stop/restart
Single launcher/child identity and parent linkage before mutation
Duplicate-start PID/creation checks and saved snapshots
Bounded stop/restart waits with exact pair disappearance/restoration
Original application ports and controller PID/creation survive both stop and restart
limits: Run by parent in verified normal profile. This reviews test helper, not test outcome. Failure preserves stage/error and may require explicit restart recovery. No physical USB cycle or Windows reboot claim.
